title: Resolving one move alone at the end of a redline leaves an empty paragraph or fails
symptom: after compare moved two paragraphs to the end of the body, accepting or rejecting only the last move by its id leaves an empty paragraph; with a table between the last moved paragraph and the one before it, the call fails with "paragraph mark removal next to a table requires a paragraph with no content left"
workaround: accept or reject every revision, or one author's, instead of a single move
